data.name: Anayansh
data.gender_notes: Anayansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anaya (god within) + Ansh (presence). This name signifies the presence of God within the heart. It is derived from the ancient Sanskrit language and is considered a powerful and spiritual name in Hindu culture. The name Anayansh carries the meaning “God in the heart” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anayansh usually hope their child will grow to embody god in the heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anayansh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Anayansh was a legendary king of the Chera dynasty in ancient Kerala, South India. He is believed to have ruled during the 11th century CE and is known for his military prowess and just rule. His reign is marked by the establishment of peace and prosperity in his kingdom.
